import json
d=json.load(open('.ai/task/batch-8ffba614b11fbda0391b-contextual-000/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-final-full.json'))
p=d['payload']
for i,c in enumerate(p['bounded_context']):
    ctx=c['context']
    head=ctx.split('source_facts_v1:')[0].strip()
    print('===',i,'|',head[:200])
    if 'source_facts_v1:' in ctx:
        f=json.loads(ctx.split('source_facts_v1:',1)[1])
        for a in f['fact']['anchors']:
            print('   anchor',a['repository'],a['public_source_path'],a['kind'],a.get('matching_lines'))
    print('   rest_keys',[k for k in c.keys() if k!='context'])
"
